thesis: The speaker describes his nonlinear career path, moving from boxing to aerospace engineering, medicine, and finally credit risk modeling at McKinsey, before returning to medicine to focus on longevity. He argues that longevity should be approached through an engineering lens of reverse engineering a desired outcome, utilizing a chart where the x-axis represents lifespan and the y-axis represents health span.
